annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pedro Hernando Flórez Porras (Senado); Gerson Lisímaco Montaño Arizala (Cámara de Representantes)
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill applies to all natural or legal persons across the AI lifecycle with territorial link or effects in Colombia.
Establishes risk categorization, transparency and accountability mechanisms, and data-handling standards.
Article 26/25 requires just-transition labour guidelines led by MinCiencias with Ministry of Labour.
Existing AI systems must adjust to the law upon entry into force.
Funding via international cooperation and public-private alliances, subject to budget availability.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Positive committee report (ponencia) for first debate on Colombia's Bill 043/2025 Senate – 324/2025 Cámara regulating AI. It justifies the bill, describes its scope, risk categorization, transparency, training, labour-transition and funding provisions, and includes comparative text tables of proposed amendments.
